titles_native.title: 私は童話作家を盗みました

description: Angela, born on her second life in a completely different world while retaining memories of her past existence. Wanting to spread the word about her favorite fairy tale writer from her previous life, Hans Christian Andersen, she opens a publishing company and achieves great success by publishing his stories. But… … “This is ridiculous!” “What do you mean it’s ridiculous?” To think there is an Andersen in this world, too?! And a very prickly and handsome one at that. For the first time in her life, Angela has ventured into recruiting a writer. Although he lives a smooth life as a knight of a high-ranking noble family, his true, gem-like talent lies elsewhere. “Writer, please sign a (lifetime) contract with me!” A romance fantasy more fairytale-like than a fairytale itself, \*\*Original Webtoon:\*\* \[KakaoPage\](https://page.kakao.com/content/62005445), \[Daum\](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%B4%EA%B0%80-%ED%9B%94%EC%B9%9C-%EC%9E%91%EA%B0%80%EB%8B%98/3559) \*\*Official Translations:\*\* \[Japanese\](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/154817)
